title: Prague Skoda 15T tram leaving the Vysehrad tunnel
alt: A red and white low-floor tram numbered 9267, destination 27 Malostranská, coming out of a stone tunnel with crenellated walls under a blue sky.

date.basis: Hand cancel 22.10.26; print date not shown

catalog.label: Subject
catalog.value: Low-floor Škoda 15T tram (reg. no. 9267) on special line 27, leaving the Vyšehrad tunnel toward Rašínovo nábřeží, Prague - as captioned on the back

catalog.label: Photograph
catalog.value: Petr Hejna, as credited on the back

catalog.label: Stamps
catalog.value: Czech Republic: round Z (foreign tariff) stamp, silhouette of Jára Cimrman, "Jedna ze 136 možných podob Járy Cimrmana - vynálezce kruhové známky" (one of 136 possible likenesses of Jára Cimrman, inventor of the round stamp), J. a M. Weigelovi 2014

catalog.label: Publisher
catalog.value: Dopravní podnik hl. m. Prahy, akciová společnost (Prague Public Transit Company), as printed on the back

tpa_note: Jára Cimrman is a fictional Czech polymath; the stamp credits him with inventing the round stamp.
